t_advice_summary_textbox.text: take note for patterns of which colours bring most points but during the game, this can change so then take note of which are giving less and go for the opposite

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to how much each colour gnome is worth, it does change throughout the game but if you try and remember, it will get you more points, if it seems like the points have got lower on one of the higher gnomes, try the opposite as it has probably changed to that one instead.
